consolidation_build_2026_11_23: Consolidation build appended 21 PMD SpriteCollab rows from the wave-2 intake's 29 new species folders (21 base species + the gimmighoulroaming form), each strictly richer than the Walk-only HGSS/EBDX source that served the species before (full AnimData anim lists, HEAD-verified HTTP 200 at bind time). 8 folders carry no Walk set (0618 stunfisk, 0683 aromatisse, 0733 toucannon, 0929 dolliv, 0945 grafaiai, 0990 irontreads, 1020 gougingfire, 1021 ragingbolt) and were not bound; those species keep their EBDX Walk coverage. Six CHUNSOFT sets (0015, 0148, 0266, 0268, 0345, 0414) declare Idle in AnimData.xml but ship no Idle-Anim.png file (those species idle on their Walk frames in the source games); their rows carry the Walk entry only and are flagged partial. Identity corrections vs the wave-2 ledger names: folder 1008 is Miraidon (not Koraidon), 0865 is Sirfetch'd, 0917 is Tarountula, 0929 is Dolliv; folder 0999's only set depicts the Roaming form and is bound to gimmighoulroaming, not base gimmighoul.
